title: This Man is Horrible at Fleeing the Police
description:
On October 10, 2021, Monroe County Sheriff’s deputies responded to a disturbance call in Sparta, WI. The caller reported her boyfriend was destroying her place and took her truck. A deputy attempted a traffic stop, however, he fled and crashed the truck into a creek. Deputies searched the area and were unsuccessful in finding him. They returned to the caller's residence to explain the situation but another individual happened to show up there as well...
